core_categories: Medical Devices; Hospital Equipment; Clinical Software; Turnkey Project Engineering
specialty_focus: Medhold is a leading independent medical device and equipment distributor in Southern Africa, supplying hospitals, private clinics, and government healthcare facilities. It specializes in distributing advanced medical technology and turnkey project engineering, and is the sole authorized distributor of the da Vinci Surgical System in South Africa. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
key_brands: GE HealthCare, Intuitive Surgical, Radiometer, Getinge, Conmed, Elekta, Acumed, Bonesupport, Arjo, Bexen Cardio, RZ Medizintechnik, Swemac, others
